J1.instructions: Does the cited primary house source already establish the exact scoped result asked for? Credit a documented positive sub-result even when the larger programme remains OPEN; distinguish scope, version, hypotheses and pending parts. Graph hits alone are not proof. A negative answer is advisory and can never veto source-backed reuse.

J2.instructions: Classify the relation of the scoped requested work to cited prior work: reaproveitar if exact result exists; completar if an existing partial result needs a specified missing part; novo only if absent and authorized; suspender if the question asks for immediate execution under an active block. If the case explicitly asks the type of residual work after a gate is lifted, report completar even though present dispatch stays blocked. This is classification, never permission.

criteria.reaproveitar: Requested scoped result already exists; reuse and cite it.
criteria.completar: Existing partial work needs an authorized missing part.
criteria.novo: Truly absent work is explicitly authorized and not suspended.
criteria.suspender: Current instructions or unresolved permission block the proposed new work.

J3.instructions: Select the member assigned by the explicit case owner or mandatory executor. Do not replace an assigned member based on perceived ability.

criteria.claude: claude-c1 or Claude Code or claude-8d

J4.instructions: What reasoning depth does the stated task need? Classify the requested operation, not the general complexity of physics mentioned in its source.

criteria.standard: Direct extraction, file metadata, checksum comparison or simple restatement; no proof audit.
criteria.deep: Proof verification, domain-sensitive mathematics, adversarial multi-step audit or technical planning.

J5.instructions: Does the cited delivery satisfy the precise criterion stated in this case, at the documented scope? Do not infer a full trace from a partial theorem. A yes is consultative pre-audit only, never final board approval.

J6.instructions: Does the candidate sentence misstate or exceed the source evidence or scope? Flag unqualified empirical CONFIRMED and denial of an explicitly documented mathematical sub-proof. Scoped mathematical validity does not require empirical 5 sigma. An explicitly located OPEN gap is honest. Judge the candidate sentence, not words quoted merely as warnings.

J7.instructions: Does the proposed action require an explicit pending operator decision under the cited local rule? Publication and opening data for verdict do. Routine read-only lookup or checksum measurement does not. Do not grant authorization.

J8.instructions: Are the two candidate records mutually incompatible for the same object, scope, version and time? Different scopes or explicitly different dates/versions alone are not contradictions. A scoped theorem and an OPEN larger construction can coexist.

nomenclature: J1-J8 reserved for Jev; operator D1-D8 remain separate historical decisions
